name: rdap-q
displayName: RDAP-Q: Adaptive Planning with Quality Gates
summary: Universal AI agent engineering protocol for evidence-first software development, calibrated scoring, and quality gates across Codex, Grok, Copilot, Antigravity, Goose, Claude, and Cline.
description: Vendor-neutral Research-Driven Adaptive Planning with Quality Gates (RDAP-Q) enables autonomous AI coding agents to execute non-trivial software tasks with disciplined evidence collection, deterministic phase execution, persistent project state, calibrated quality scoring (0-10 scale), and diminishing-return exit logic. Native support for OpenAI Codex, xAI Grok, GitHub Copilot, Google Antigravity, Block Goose, Anthropic Claude, and Cline.

commands./rdapq: Execute task using RDAP-Q protocol with evidence gathering and adaptive quality gates.
commands./rdapq status: Inspect current lifecycle phase, quality scorecard, confidence levels, and active gates.
commands./rdapq score: Calculate or display the current calibrated 8-dimension scorecard.
commands./rdapq audit: Trigger the adversarial final-audit verification checklist.
commands./rdapq resume: Safely reload persistent project state and verify environment drift before continuing.
commands./rdapq memory: Query durable cross-session patterns, lessons, and constraints.
commands./rdapq research: Initiate structured evidence gathering and discovery for the current task.
commands./rdapq explain: Provide transparent rationale for the current quality decision or state transition.
